claim_separation: Compressed transport decompression, digest checks and selected semantic-field inspection are metadata/data handling, not a reference ledger encoder/decoder or target-code execution.
Accepted=true means intended format acceptance, including negative/unqualified fragments; it does not mean successful physical API history or runtime qualification.
The full-cap API0 base is an intentionally invalid layout/extent control, not a source-valid full roster or empirical memory/time fit.
The four future methods call only codec entrypoints with ordinary values/raw bytes; no expected result, case ID or fault selector is passed into target code.

Actual first-slot ordering, diagnostic borrow/release, generated byte/context ownership and legacy48 opaque identity remain queued genuine producer-integration tests. Pure codec roundtrip cannot supply them.
